## Où j'en suis

The `cmd/replay` tool is written and committed (`4e2d9b7`, `f13a06c`), and PR #233 is open for review with Daniel as reviewer. The dry run on the 12/11 window (14:10–17:40 UTC) found 18,442,107 events to replay into `events.replay.v3`, none already in the dedup store, and 3,118 schema v2 lines written to the rejects file. The real replay and the aggregator backfill have not run.

- [en-cours] Waiting for Daniel's review of PR #233 before the real replay.
- [prochaine-étape] Get PR #233 reviewed and merged. Run the real replay into `events.replay.v3` with `--dry-run=false`. Run the aggregator with `--backfill` for 2026-11-12. Give Rachel the ETA for Fernhill and Orbitly by Friday.
- [essai-raté] The dry run `replay-dryrun-1` was OOMKilled at `--batch 50000` (about 2.6 GiB peak against a 2 GiB limit). `replay-dryrun-2` at `--batch 5000` completed in 19m42s with 310 MiB peak.
- [essai-raté] `TestStreamWindow_OrderWithinPartition` failed because 4 workers read the same hour concurrently and broke per-partition order. Fixed by assigning each partition to one worker.
- [question] The ETA for Rachel (Fernhill and Orbitly, by Friday) is still open. You will give it yourself after Daniel's review.
- [décision] Replay everything into `events.replay.v3`, never into `events.v3`, with no age cutoff, and let the aggregator recompute 12/11 with `--backfill` (source: t05)
- [décision] Use a 5k batch and leave the namespace memory limit untouched (source: t13)
- [décision] Write the malformed lines to a rejects file in the bucket and do not skip them silently (source: t15)
- [décision] Do not draft a reply to Rachel; you will send the ETA after Daniel's review (source: t19)
